description: Result of regenerating all nginx host configs

checked.description: Enabled hosts that were regenerated or tried

regenerated.description: Hosts that are online with their new config

offline.description: Hosts nginx rejected, they are offline now. Also lists hosts the final nginx test took offline that were not checked (eg. of a host type that was not selected)

failed.description: Hosts whose config could not be generated (eg. a missing certificate file), they keep their previous config

warnings.description: Online hosts with custom locations that are disabled or don't resolve right now
